title: Windsurf alternatives
summary: Windsurf alternatives: candidate paths, switching costs and reasons to keep the original.

sections.heading: Match the reason to a candidate
paragraphs: Cursor is an editor candidate; Copilot is worth evaluating in an established GitHub workflow; Cline is a provider-configurable candidate. These are trial directions, not drop-in compatibility promises.

sections.heading: When to keep the original
paragraphs: Do not migrate merely because a URL redirected. Confirm vendor continuity, export your settings and price the disruption before changing the working environment.

sections.heading: Migration rehearsal
paragraphs: Create a copy of the project, remove production secrets, export data using a documented method and run the tests in the candidate workflow. Compare the work needed to restore service after a failed change. Keep the original until the rehearsal succeeds.

verdict: First distinguish an account-transition problem from a coding-workflow problem.
bestFor: Existing Windsurf users with a specific workflow, budget or ownership constraint
notFor: Readers expecting a replacement to move code, data and infrastructure automatically
migration: Trial the candidate on a branch; retain the original workflow until tests, export and billing checks pass.
